project_info.network_architecture: Multi-tier cloud architecture with VPN/Direct Connect connectivity for customer-hosted systems, separated into ingestion, storage, processing, and consumption layers with comprehensive management and security layer

Data Lake (AWS Lake Formation, Amazon S3, AWS Glue)
Data Processing (AWS Glue Crawlers, AWS Glue Data Catalog)
Machine Learning Platform (Amazon SageMaker, Amazon EC2)
Management and Security Layer (IAM, KMS, GuardDuty, Macie, Config, CloudTrail, CloudWatch)
project_info.\"architecture_type\": "Cloud-native Data Analytics Platform with Microservices Components",
project_info.\"description\": "Processed data queried and analyzed through Athena, QuickSight, and custom applications"
